name: Traveler's Judgment 5

perks.name: QuickDot SAS
perks.desc:
Agile Sidearm sight. 
  •  Greatly increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Control SAS
perks.desc:
Stable Sidearm sight. 
  •  Increases handling speed
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Shortspec SAS
perks.desc:
Balanced Sidearm sight. 
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Slightly increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases range

perks.name: Tactic SAS
perks.desc:
Accurate Sidearm sight. 
  •  Slightly increases range

perks.name: Target SAS
perks.desc:
Sharp Sidearm sight.
  •  Increases range
  •  Slightly decreases stability
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed

Pinpoint Sidearm sight.

perks.name: Extended Mag
perks.desc:
This weapon has a greatly increased magazine size, but reloads much slower.
  •  Greatly increases magazine size
  •  Greatly decreases reload speed
  •  Increases airborne effectiveness

perks.name: Alloy Magazine
perks.desc: Faster reload when the magazine is nearly empty.

perks.name: Appended Mag
perks.desc:
This weapon's magazine is built for higher capacity.
  •  Increases magazine size

perks.name: Armor-Piercing Rounds
perks.desc:
Rounds cause extra damage to combatants' shields and overpenetrate targets. 
  •  Slightly increases range

perks.name: High-Caliber Rounds
perks.desc:
Shots from this weapon knock the target back farther.
  •  Slightly increases range

perks.name: Ricochet Rounds
perks.desc:
Rounds ricochet off hard surfaces. 
  •  Increases stability 
  •  Slightly increases range

perks.name: Flared Magwell
perks.desc:
Optimized for fast reloading.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Greatly increases reload speed

perks.name: Light Mag
perks.desc:
Improved reload and range.
  •  Increases reload speed
  •  Slightly increases range

perks.name: Accurized Rounds
perks.desc:
This weapon can fire longer distances.
  •  Increases range

perks.name: Tactical Mag
perks.desc:
This weapon has multiple tactical improvements.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Increases reload speed
  •  Slightly increases magazine size

perks.name: Drop Mag
perks.desc: Increases reload speed but reduces magazine size.

perks.name: Steady Rounds
perks.desc:
This magazine is optimized for recoil control.
  •  Greatly increases stability 
  •  Slightly decreases range
  •  Increases airborne effectiveness

perks.name: Firmly Planted
perks.desc: Increased accuracy, stability, and handling when firing while crouched.

perks.name: Rapid Hit
perks.desc: Rapid precision hits temporarily increase stability and reload speed.

perks.name: Hip-Fire Grip
perks.desc: Increases accuracy, stability, and precision hit targeting when firing from the hip.

perks.name: Feeding Frenzy
perks.desc: Each rapid kill with this weapon progressively increases reload speed for a short time.

perks.name: Field Prep
perks.desc: Increases ammo generation. Faster reload, stow, and ready speed when you're crouching.

perks.name: Auto-Loading Holster
perks.desc: The holstered weapon is automatically reloaded after a short period of time.

perks.name: Surrounded
perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus damage when three or more enemies are in close proximity.

perks.name: Tap the Trigger
perks.desc: Grants a short period of increased stability and accuracy on initial trigger pull.

perks.name: Headseeker
perks.desc: Body shots landed with this weapon increase precision damage and aim assist for a short time. Body shots landed while the perk is active refresh the time.

perks.name: Disruption Break
perks.desc: Breaking an enemy's shield with this weapon makes them more vulnerable to Kinetic damage for a brief period.

perks.name: Dragonfly
perks.desc: Precision kills create an elemental damage explosion.

perks.name: Shield Disorient
perks.desc: Energy matched shield explosion disorients nearby combatants.

notes: Mercules904 notes (must have PvP): "This is perhaps the gun I am most excited to get my hands on from the set. [...] Stat-wise the gun is straight up competitive, boasting very high base stability for a sidearm, and above average range, plus a decent mag size (equivalent to 10 bursts), and decent aim assist. Indeed, the only real drawback is below average recoil direction, and even that is manageable."
